name: Dual-Node Failure & Autonomous Local Recovery
description: Primary Phase 6 Benchmark: Nominal flight baseline, followed by dual-node failure: critical relay transmitter loss on SAT-04 in Plane A at t=2.0s, followed by moderate compute failure on SAT-02 at t=4.0s. Demonstrates autonomous fault detection, peer observation, intra-plane relay role reassignment in Plane A to an eligible healthy observer, flight software watchdog reset recovery for SAT-02, and local link preservation without manual operator intervention. Note: SAT-07 is a bootstrap coordinator assigned during swarm initialization; relay role reassignment preserves local ISL connectivity for the promoted node rather than establishing global end-to-end network connectivity across partitioned components.
